    """
    Given two positive integers a and b, return the even digits between a
    and b.
    """

Clarification: Despite the name, it means numbers that are themselves even (i % 2 == 0), not numbers composed of even digits; e.g. generate_integers(2,8) returns [2,4,6,8], the even NUMBERS in that range.

candidates.answer: Handled via min(a,b)/max(a,b), so the function normalizes order automatically and returns the same result as if a<=b (per the docstring: generate_integers(8,2) => [2,4,6,8]).
